features.quote: Bounded turns (`max_turns`, default 25) and wall-clock per task.
When budget is exhausted the trajectory is closed and judged on what happened.
The env exposes a `declare_infeasible(reason)` tool... using it is a legitimate way to complete a task.
features.justification_quote: without it we'd be measuring whether the model guesses there's a trapdoor, not whether it stays honest
